qualifications.finding: Every planetary cause profile follows the topical carrier-selection method; none is an unconditional natal label.
Jupiter occurs as topic ruler with historical causes and as an afflicted contextual witness; generic benefic identity is not a universal override.
Natural classification requires its actual antecedents. Its negation is not equivalent to the source violent branch.
Sign categories, constellation figures and angular locations are different predicates; alternatives and intensifiers remain marked.
Event kind, conspicuousness/magnitude, compounded circumstances, burial and geography are separate outputs.
